content: AOS Orwell About AOS Orwell Indigenous capability. Global standards. Integrated energy solutions. AOS Orwell is one of Africa’s leading indigenous energy service companies, delivering integrated products, engineering solutions and operational support across the oil and gas value chain. Explore our journey arrow_downward Explore our services arrow_forward 1981 Delivering energy solutions for over four decades Who we are Empowering the energy industry with integrated expertise We are an all-inclusive provider of integrated, specialised oilfield products and solutions across the oil and gas value chain. Our total-package model enables us to support sizeable projects from planning, procurement and supply-chain coordination through engineering, execution, operations and maintenance. Today, we are one of the foremost indigenous oilfield servicing companies in the country, supporting clients with integrated expertise throughout the asset lifecycle. We do this by maintaining very high standards of behaviour and operations that result in a world-class quality workforce, products and service delivery. Honesty and Integrity Our business is open and transparent, with high regard for fairness and equality, while we remain committed to maintaining high ethical standards in all our dealings. Customer Focus We foster quality, strategic and lasting relationships with our customers because we understand their needs and how to meet those needs in a way that transforms them into satisfied, loyal brand advocates. Innovation We have stayed successful over the years by deploying cutting-edge technology and transferring knowledge to create value through our products and services. Our capabilities span process-control platforms, safety systems, programmable automation, industrial data, environmental monitoring, operational technology security and pipeline surveillance. Supervisory control SCADA Our Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition solutions provide centralized monitoring and control of industrial processes, equipment and geographically distributed assets. We integrate field devices, Remote Terminal Units, control systems, communication networks and operator interfaces into a unified operational platform. Through real-time visualization, alarm management, historical data collection and remote operational control, our SCADA solutions help operators identify abnormal conditions quickly, improve decision-making and maintain reliable production across both local and remote facilities. Integrated control and safety Integrated Control & Safety Systems We are an in-country partner providing Integrated Control and Safety System solutions for process automation with SIL 3 integrity. We operate one of Africa’s largest Exida-approved ICSS assembly facilities, enabling us to provide advanced system integration for the oil and gas, power, renewable energy, water and healthcare industries. Our ICSS solutions provide both process-control and safety functions by operating the Basic Process Control System and Safety Instrumented System on a common platform. The systems can be delivered as a complete integrated package or provided as separate control and safety services according to the project’s operational requirements. Programmable automation Programmable Logic Controllers Our PLC solutions provide reliable and flexible automation for machines, process units, utility systems and packaged equipment. We support PLC system design, hardware selection, control-panel assembly, software development, testing, commissioning and integration with field instrumentation and supervisory systems. We also support system upgrades, migration of obsolete control platforms, redundant controller architectures, communication interface development and troubleshooting of existing automation systems. Industrial digitalization Digital Solutions Our Digital Solutions integrate industrial automation, field instrumentation and digital technologies to provide real-time visibility into operations and asset performance. Environmental performance Greenhouse Emissions Monitoring Our Greenhouse Emissions Monitoring solutions help operators accurately measure, monitor and report greenhouse gas emissions to support regulatory compliance, ESG reporting and sustainability goals. Using advanced monitoring technologies and integrated data solutions, we deliver reliable emissions data that enables clients to improve environmental performance, optimize operations and make informed decisions with confidence. Operational technology protection Cybersecurity Solutions Our industrial cybersecurity solutions help protect operational technology environments, automation systems and critical process infrastructure against unauthorized access, disruption and emerging digital threats. Our approach can include OT cybersecurity assessments, network segmentation, secure remote access, system hardening, user-access controls, backup and recovery planning, vulnerability management and continuous security monitoring. By integrating security requirements into the automation lifecycle, we help clients strengthen system resilience while preserving the availability and safety of critical operations. Pipeline surveillance Pipeline Leak Detection Our Pipeline Leak Detection solutions provide continuous monitoring of pipeline operating conditions to support the early identification of leaks, abnormal flow behaviour and potential integrity events. By integrating pressure, flow, temperature and other available field data with analytical monitoring tools, alarm systems and SCADA platforms, operators can detect possible losses more quickly and coordinate an effective operational response. The solution can be configured for transmission pipelines, gathering networks and other critical fluid-transfer systems to improve environmental protection, production accountability and pipeline availability. content: AOS Orwell arrow_back Back to all insights Well Construction Optimizing Casing Running Through Automated Tubular Running Systems How automation, real-time monitoring and precision-controlled equipment can improve casing-running safety, consistency and operational performance. AOS Orwell 27 May 2025 15 min read Automated casing-running technology supports safer, faster and more consistent tubular-running operations. Casing and tubing running sit at the intersection of speed, precision, safety and well integrity. Automation makes it possible to improve all four. In many fields, manual tubular-running methods are still being deployed. These operations depend heavily on manually operated equipment and expose personnel to avoidable red-zone risks, handling hazards and connection inconsistencies. Skilled crews have delivered successful results for decades, but many of the risks associated with manual handling and inconsistent connection make-up are no longer necessary in today’s automated operating environment. Unplanned failures, casing strings that do not reach their intended depth and non-productive time can directly affect AFE days and project cost. This makes tubular running a critical area for improving operational efficiency. The operational challenge Non-productive time is often a silent drain on project efficiency, particularly during operations where speed, precision and connection integrity must work together. Enter automated tubular-running systems Automated tubular-running systems introduce intelligent control and greater consistency to every connection. Top-drive make-up tools allow each casing joint to be handled with improved precision while reducing the need for manual intervention. By controlling connection make-up and monitoring operating parameters in real time, these systems help crews perform tubular-running activities more safely and consistently. health_and_safety Improved safety Reduced manual handling and lower exposure to red-zone activities. speed Greater efficiency Faster and more consistent connection handling throughout the operation. precision_manufacturing Connection precision Controlled make-up parameters improve repeatability across the casing string. monitoring Real-time visibility Torque-turn monitoring provides immediate feedback during each connection. Real-time monitoring supports well integrity Wireless monitoring and torque-turn systems provide real-time feedback during the connection process. This allows operating teams to confirm that make-up parameters remain within the required range and identify potential issues earlier. Automation does more than reduce operating time. It improves consistency across the entire casing and tubing process. Fewer manual interventions can mean fewer handling errors, reduced exposure and better control of connection quality. Maintaining connection integrity from the beginning helps reduce downtime and supports the overall optimization of tubular-running operations. AOS Orwell’s approach to casing and tubular running At AOS Orwell, our approach to Casing and Tubular Running Services is built around speed, accuracy, safety and reliability. We deploy automated technologies that support precise and consistent well-construction operations. In today’s oilfield, every connection matters. We do not simply run tubulars; we support operations designed to deliver measurable performance, reduce avoidable risk and protect well integrity. Whether you are planning a new well or seeking to improve the performance of an existing tubular-running programme, our team can provide precision-driven CTR solutions. content: Supply Chain Disruptions and Oilfield Equipment Availability | AOS Orwell arrow_back Back to all insights Industry & Supply Chain Optimizing Casing Running Through Automated Tubular Running Systems How global supply constraints, longer lead times and equipment shortages affect oilfield operations—and how flexible sourcing strategies can keep projects moving. AOS Orwell 27 February 2025 15 min read Oilfield projects depend on timely access to specialised equipment, tubulars and intervention tools. In the oil and gas industry, equipment availability can determine whether an operation proceeds as planned or becomes an expensive delay. A well that is not drilled on schedule, a maintenance operation that is delayed or a missing piece of critical equipment can result in significant financial setbacks. The smooth flow of oilfield operations depends on a reliable supply chain and timely access to the correct tools. For operators, supply-chain challenges are more than inconveniences. They can threaten efficiency, project timelines and overall cost. A routine well intervention may be halted because an essential downhole tool is unavailable, while a drilling programme may be delayed by late tubular delivery. The central question The question is no longer whether supply-chain disruptions will occur, but how prepared operators are to respond when they do. The growing complexity of oilfield supply chains The oilfield supply chain is intricate and global. Equipment used in well construction, maintenance and intervention is often manufactured across several continents. Drill pipe may originate in Asia, casing accessories in Europe and control systems in North America before reaching an operating location in West Africa or the Middle East. With so many moving parts, even a small disruption can create a wider operational impact. Geopolitical tensions, economic instability, trade restrictions and raw-material shortages can create bottlenecks. Rising shipping costs, port congestion and workforce shortages can further extend lead times and increase the cost of essential equipment. schedule Longer lead times International sourcing delays can disrupt project schedules and planned maintenance windows. payments Higher costs Urgent sourcing, logistics constraints and limited availability can increase procurement expenditure. warning Operational risk Teams may be forced to improvise or use less suitable equipment when critical tools are unavailable. inventory_2 Equipment shortages Limited stock can delay drilling, intervention and maintenance activities. The real impact on operations A disruption in oilfield-equipment availability can have serious operational consequences. Drilling teams may need to revise well plans because specific tubular sizes are unavailable. Intervention crews may also have to rely on older tools while newer and more efficient options remain delayed in transit. The effect goes beyond schedule delay. When companies are forced to improvise, operational efficiency can decline, safety margins may shrink and unplanned costs can increase. Many operators are therefore taking a more strategic approach. Some are diversifying their supplier base to avoid over-reliance on one region or manufacturer. Others are investing in local manufacturing and service capability to reduce dependency on imports. Rentals provide flexibility when procurement is delayed Equipment rental offers operators immediate access to critical tools without the uncertainty of extended procurement lead times. This can be particularly valuable for downhole tools, fishing tools and tubulars required for time-sensitive operations. At AOS Orwell, we have seen operators prioritise rental solutions to keep projects moving during periods of supply-chain disruption. Rentals can reduce waiting time, provide cost-effective flexibility and ensure that the required equipment is available when needed. Locally available tubular inventory can reduce delays caused by international procurement. Flexible equipment access supports faster mobilisation and improved project continuity. Building a more resilient sourcing strategy Supply-chain disruption will remain a possibility in oilfield operations. Companies that anticipate risk, secure reliable alternatives and make timely procurement decisions will be better positioned to protect project schedules and maintain competitiveness. In an industry where time directly affects cost, the ability to respond quickly can mean the difference between a successful operation and a costly delay. title: Welcome to Women’s Month: International Women’s Day 2022
description: AOS Orwell celebrates International Women’s Day 2022, recognises the achievements of women and reinforces its commitment to challenging workplace bias and supporting inclusion.
content: Welcome to Women’s Month: International Women’s Day 2022 | AOS Orwell arrow_back Back to all insights People & Community Welcome to Women’s Month: International Women’s Day 2022 Celebrating women’s achievements, confronting workplace bias and supporting greater inclusion across organisations and society. AOS Orwell 8 March 2022 15 min read AOS Orwell joins women around the world in marking International Women’s Day 2022. March is Women’s Month—a time to celebrate women’s achievements while drawing attention to issues that continue to affect equality, inclusion and opportunity. Welcome to the month of March and to Women’s Month: a period set aside to celebrate, highlight and discuss important issues that may have been overlooked in the continued fight for women’s rights. In 1975, the United Nations began celebrating International Women’s Day and invited member states to recognise 8 March as a day dedicated to women’s rights and world peace. International Women’s Day 2022 The theme, “Break the Bias,” calls attention to the visible and less-visible forms of bias women experience within workplaces and across society. Recognising the realities of workplace bias Women continue to experience different forms of bias within and outside the workplace in Nigeria and around the world. These challenges include gender inequality, persistent glass ceilings, income disparities, limited workplace inclusion and inadequate support for expectant and nursing mothers. Addressing these issues requires more than awareness. It requires organisations and individuals to examine workplace culture, decision-making processes and the opportunities available to women. equalizer Gender equality Creating equitable opportunities for women across roles and levels of responsibility. trending_up Career progression Supporting women as they move into leadership and senior-management positions. diversity_3 Workplace inclusion Building working environments where women are represented, respected and heard. balance Fair opportunity Challenging structures and practices that restrict equal access and participation. Women are taking their seats at the table Despite the challenges, more women are rising to the occasion and taking their rightful seats at the table. Women are chairing company boards, including within Fortune 500 organisations, taking on more senior management roles and breaking through long-standing glass ceilings. These achievements demonstrate the importance of visibility, opportunity, support and representation. They also show what becomes possible when barriers are recognised and actively challenged. AOS Orwell’s International Women’s Day event In commemoration of International Women’s Day 2022, AOS Orwell will host a virtual event for its women. The event will provide an opportunity for participants to listen, learn and network with seasoned and successful women who have challenged bias and broken barriers in their respective fields. Listen. Learn. Connect. Meaningful conversations and professional networks can help more women develop confidence, access opportunity and pursue leadership. Our commitment to supporting women As an organisation, AOS Orwell remains committed to the continued advancement of women’s rights in the workplace. We support efforts aimed at helping women challenge existing bias, break barriers and achieve success in their chosen careers and fields of endeavour. AOS Orwell Limited congratulates women around the world on the celebration of International Women’s Day and wishes them continued success as they attain greater heights. International Women’s Day Together, we can challenge bias and create greater opportunity AOS Orwell remains committed to supporting inclusion, professional development and meaningful opportunities for women. content: Bayo Adebiyi | Director | AOS Orwell Board Leadership Bayo Adebiyi Director An accomplished E&P executive with more than three decades of global oil and gas experience spanning operations, commercial leadership, marketing, business development, account management and executive management. 30+ Years of oil & gas experience Global Africa, Europe, Middle East & North America E&P Operations and commercial leadership Profile Global energy leadership built across more than three decades. Bayo Adebiyi is a focused and passionate leader, communicator and mentor who has managed multidisciplinary and multicultural teams of directors and commercial managers across the global exploration and production industry. content: AOS Orwell Powering intelligent infrastructure Electrical & Instrumentation Solutions AOS Orwell delivers turnkey, multi-disciplinary engineering, asset integration, and lifecycle management for complex power distribution, process automation, and safety-critical infrastructures. Our engineering workflows seamlessly integrate heavy electrical switchgear with digital control topography to ensure peak operational availability and safety. At AOS Orwell, we engineer physical electrical infrastructure to act as an intelligent node within your digital enterprise. By leveraging deep strategic alliances with global technology leaders—including ABB,Eaton, and Vertiv—we deliver localized engineering execution that preserves OEM warranty integrity while satisfying rigorous local content mandates. From high-voltage isolation to sub-millisecond safety-logic handshakes, our systems are built for deterministic performance in the most challenging operating environments across the region. Engineered packages Modular E-House Solutions Our custom-designed, structurally optimized, and fully integrated modular Electrical Houses (E-Houses) provide turnkey power distribution and control solutions engineered specifically for demanding onshore and offshore applications. We serve critical sectors including Oil & Gas, Power Generation, and Petrochemicals, delivering robust infrastructure capable of withstanding the world's harshest operating conditions—from extreme offshore platforms to highly corrosive coastal environments. Every unit is precision-engineered to meet stringent regulatory and safety standards. Our structures feature advanced blast-rated designs and high-performance fire insulation (H-60 and A-60 ratings) to safeguard critical assets and personnel. To ensure total equipment protection and seamless field deployment, our engineering process fully integrates complex structural load dynamics, specialized HVAC climate control systems, and strict compliance with localized Hazardous Area Classifications, including ATEX and IECEx Zone 1 and Zone 2 requirements. Every E-House undergoes comprehensive testing and commissioning prior to delivery, ensuring it is fully operational from the moment it arrives on-site through a Plug-and-Play concept. Power distribution Low-Voltage & Medium-Voltage Switchgears and Motor Control Centers Operating as a certified local partner aligned with premier global OEMs—including Schneider Electric, ABB, and Eaton—we provide fully type-tested, locally assembled, and factory-validated low-voltage switchgears, intelligent Motor Control Centers (iMCCs), and main distribution boards. By fabricating and assembling these systems locally to strict OEM design topologies, we ensure absolute compliance with international safety and performance standards while maximizing local content value. Beyond our low-voltage capabilities, our strong strategic partnerships with these OEMs allow us to deliver state-of-the-art medium-voltage switchgears equipped with advanced arc-flash mitigation technologies. These highly specialized systems are critical for safely receiving power from primary generation sources and distributing it reliably across the entire network architecture. This infrastructure handles everything from bulk power delivery to high-capacity consumer assets such as export pumps, down to secondary distribution networks via Ring Main Units (RMUs), and finally to localized equipment through step-down transformers. This collaborative model ensures that every piece of infrastructure leaving our facility combines world-class engineering with localized agility, rigorous quality control, and dedicated technical support. Digital grid intelligence Substation Automation At AOS Orwell, we design and deploy high-availability Substation Automation Systems (SAS) that turn traditional electrical infrastructure into intelligent, self-healing networks. Backed by our strategic alliances with ABB, Schneider Electric, and Eaton, our engineering teams build open-architecture networks using IEC 61850 standards. We configure sub-4-millisecond GOOSE messaging across advanced Intelligent Electronic Devices (IEDs) to handle critical protection schemes such as high-speed interlocking and arc-flash mitigation before a fault can spread. By bridging type-tested switchgears with industrial UPS backbones, our systems run smart, high-speed load-shedding algorithms during grid anomalies while streaming field telemetry over Modbus TCP or DNP3 into the OSIsoft PI historian. The result is total asset visibility, robust safety isolation, and operational resilience that can be relied on across demanding industrial environments. Grid resilience Transformers Managing heavy electrical loads in volatile grid environments demands highly resilient, custom-engineered equipment that eliminates single points of failure. At AOS Orwell, we engineer and provision an elite portfolio of power-hardening infrastructure spanning medium-voltage power transformers, localized distribution transformers, oil-immersed units, and specialized dry-type cast-resin architectures. Built to strict IEC and IEEE standards, our transformers are meticulously designed for high dielectric strength, superior short-circuit withstand capabilities, and optimized thermal performance across industrial, offshore, and heavy commercial applications. Recognizing that standard solutions rarely fit complex project scopes, we collaborate with our OEM partners to design custom-built, highly engineered transformer packages—balancing impedance matching, harmonic load mitigation, and structural footprint constraints to deliver absolute operational safety and grid resilience. Industrial illumination Lighting & Controls When operating in harsh, heavy-industrial or hazardous environments, lighting is not only about visibility—it is a critical safety parameter and a major operational expense. At AOS Orwell, we design and deploy high-performance indoor, outdoor, and explosion-proof lighting architectures engineered to maximize luminous efficacy while reducing lifecycle maintenance costs. Partnering with Eaton, a global pioneer in industrial illumination, we deliver ruggedized LED solutions and intelligent control systems built to withstand extreme thermal stresses, heavy vibration, and corrosive coastal atmospheres. Our Subject Matter Experts work directly with client engineering teams to map critical deployment factors—from photometrics and lumen maintenance (L70/B50 ratings) to strict ATEX and IECEx Zone 1 and Zone 2 hazardous-area classifications. By integrating Eaton's smart control topologies with existing plant infrastructure, we help facilities achieve optimized optical performance, deterministic safety compliance, and substantial reductions in energy consumption. Power continuity UPS and Battery Management Systems When critical operations run around the clock, a power interruption is more than an inconvenience—it can trigger a costly shutdown. At AOS Orwell, we engineer industrial-grade Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) and Battery Management Systems (BMS) designed to guarantee absolute power continuity for safety-critical control and instrumentation loops. Partnering with global power technology leaders such as Vertiv, our multi-disciplinary teams integrate ruggedized, high-fault-tolerant UPS architectures engineered to survive severe transient surges and harmonic distortion. We pair these systems with intelligent BMS configurations that continuously monitor cell health, internal resistance, and thermal states, eliminating the blind spots that lead to sudden battery-bank failures. Through native communication protocols such as Modbus TCP and Profibus, system data can be remotely monitored and logged to support preventive maintenance and performance management. The result is a hardened, transparent power-backup infrastructure that executes emergency shutdown and load-shedding handshakes reliably, keeping operations resilient when the grid goes dark. © 2025 AOS Orwell. content: AOS Orwell Early detection and emergency protection Fire & Gas Systems AOS Orwell provides integrated fire and gas detection, alarm, control and suppression solutions designed to protect personnel, facilities, critical equipment and the environment. Our solutions combine reliable field detection, intelligent safety-system integration and appropriate emergency-response functions for industrial and hazardous-area applications. Integrated hazard detection Protection from initial detection to emergency response Our Fire & Gas solutions are designed around the hazards, operating conditions and emergency-response requirements of each facility. We integrate detectors, alarm devices, safety control panels, shutdown interfaces and suppression equipment into a coordinated protection system that supports early warning and rapid response. Detect Rapid identification of flame, gas and smoke hazards Alarm Clear audible, visual and control-room notification Isolate Integration with shutdown and emergency-control functions Suppress Appropriate fire-control solutions for identified hazards Optical flame detection Flame Detectors Our Flame detectors are certified solutions (such as SIL 2/FM/CSA/ATEX/IECEx) for hazardous industrial fire and safety environments for over four decades. Our optical flame detectors combine sophisticated algorithms with detection technologies such as ultraviolet (UV), infrared (IR), UVIR, dual IR and multispectrum IR, to boost detection while minimizing false alarms. Ultraviolet flame detectors, Single frequency & Multi-spectrum Single Frequency and Multi-spectrum infrared flame detectors Multi-spectrum infrared Hydrogen Flame Detectors Available as Conventional (mA) and Addressable (EQP) models Detector selection and positioning should be based on the facility’s fire-risk assessment, potential fuel sources, obstructions and required coverage. Hazardous gas monitoring Gas Detectors We offer Combustible, toxic, gas leak and oxygen depletion detectors for personnel, process and asset protection Our OEM products has designed and manufactured certified gas detection solutions for hazardous industrial environments for over 30 years. During this time, we have developed a broad line of innovative and reliable gas detectors, with our acoustic and line-of-sight models winning exida safety awards. Combustible and hydrocarbon gas detection Toxic gas detection for gases such as hydrogen sulphide, carbon monoxide, chlorine, hydrogen, nitrogen etc Oxygen-deficiency and oxygen-enrichment monitoring Point and open-path gas detection Acoustic Leak Detector Available with Conventional (mA) and Addressable (EQP) models Gas-detector location should consider gas density, ventilation, release points, process conditions and the facility’s hazard analysis. Alarm and notification devices FGS Alarming Accessories Our fire and gas alarming accessories support effective notification, manual activation and emergency response across industrial and hazardous-area environments. These accessories are selected to complement field-detection systems and provide reliable warning, signalling and local response support. Beacons designed for use in potentially explosive atmospheres and harsh environmental conditions Manual fire alarm call points designed for use in flammable atmospheres and harsh environmental conditions High-power explosion-proof sounders certified for use across a wide temperature range Combined audio/visual units with certified beacon and sounder configurations Loudspeakers intended for use in potentially explosive atmospheres Smoke, heat and multi-sensor photoelectric detector options with LED indication and polycarbonate housing Accessories should be selected in line with the site hazard classification, notification requirements and emergency-response philosophy. Integrated safety response Fire & Gas Detection Safety Systems & Suppression Systems We provide integrated Fire & Gas safety systems that receive signals from field detectors, evaluate alarm conditions and initiate predefined responses through an approved cause-and-effect strategy. The system can generate audible and visual alarms, communicate with control-room interfaces, initiate equipment shutdown, close isolation valves, stop ventilation systems and activate the appropriate fire-suppression response. Suppression solutions are selected according to the identified fire hazard, protected area, occupancy and equipment type. Systems may include water-based, foam, gaseous, clean-agent, water-mist, deluge or localized suppression arrangements. Fire and gas control panels Safety logic and cause-and-effect programming Audible alarms, beacons and emergency notification Emergency shutdown and ventilation-system interfaces Deluge, foam, water-mist and gaseous suppression solutions System testing, commissioning and functional verification Suppression-system selection must be based on the protected hazard and applicable project, fire-safety, environmental and regulatory requirements. Very early smoke detection Smoke Detection (VESDA – Very Early Smoke Detection Apparatus) Very Early Smoke Detection Apparatus systems provide continuous air sampling for the early identification of smoke particles, often before smoke becomes visible or conventional detectors enter alarm. Air is drawn through a network of sampling pipes and analysed by a highly sensitive detector. Multiple alarm levels can be configured to provide early warning, investigation time and staged emergency response. Aspirating smoke detection is particularly suitable for critical environments where conventional point detectors may be difficult to access, too slow or affected by high airflow. description: Measurement Solutions | AOS Orwell Precision instrumentation & process intelligence Measurement Solutions Reliable measurement technologies for level, pressure, flow, temperature, custody transfer, process analysis and f
content: Measurement Solutions | AOS Orwell Precision instrumentation & process intelligence Measurement Solutions Reliable measurement technologies for level, pressure, flow, temperature, custody transfer, process analysis and flare gas monitoring across demanding industrial applications. Explore solutions arrow_downward Talk to our team Process measurement Accurate data. Better process decisions. Measurement is central to safe, efficient and reliable process operations. AOS Orwell provides instrumentation and packaged measurement solutions across critical industrial process variables. The portfolio supports process visibility, operational safety, custody transfer, plant optimization and environmental monitoring across oil and gas and other industrial applications. Precision Measurement technologies for critical process variables. Integration Field instrumentation through complete packaged systems. Visibility Reliable process and diagnostic data for operations. Level Measurement Level Continuous level measurement and point level detection in fluids and bulk solids. Constant product quality, plant safety, economic efficiency and digitalization are important aspects for any level measuring point. Our complete level instrument portfolio provides extensive configuration possibilities for specific process requirements. Instruments are available with trade-specific and safety-relevant certificates and approvals. Tank gauging solutions can also be configured for storage tanks and stilling wells. Pressure Measurement Pressure Transmitters Process and differential pressure measurement in acids, sludges, gases or vapors. Pressure is one of the most important measured variables in process automation. Digital functions make diagnostic and process information available in real time and can enable guided device verification and documentation without interrupting the process. Sensors must satisfy the specific requirements of each application from development through final production. Process application Measurement where the process happens. Pressure instrumentation is deployed directly within demanding process environments where accurate, continuous and reliable measurement is required. Flow Measurement Flow Meters High-performance flowmeters for liquids, gases and steam. Consistent product quality, safety, process optimization and environmental protection are among the reasons industrial flow measurement continues to grow in importance. Applications include wastewater, water, beverages, mineral oil, chemicals, natural gas and steam. The Proline product family provides digital capabilities including WLAN or Bluetooth, web-server and touchscreen operation, HistoROM data management and Heartbeat Technology. FLOWSIC ultrasonic technology supports applications including custody transfer, flare gas measurement, tunnel monitoring and emissions monitoring. Temperature Measurement Temperature Transmitters Thermometers and transmitters for the process industry. Temperature is the most frequently measured variable in process engineering. The product portfolio complies with international standards and specifications including ATEX, FM, CSA, IEC, NEPSI, SIL, NAMUR, DNV GL, 3-A, EHEDG, ASME BPE, FDA, EAC and INMETRO. The instrumentation is suitable for use across industrial sectors. Custody Transfer Metering Skids / LACT Unit We offer Coriolis and ultrasonic-based custody transfer metering, loading, unloading and LACT units with mass or volume output. Applications include custody transfers, asset transfers, terminals, depots, refineries, pipelines and process plants. These systems are designed to minimize downtime, increase availability, support accurate measurement and improve operational efficiency. Pressure Regulation Pressure Reduction Metering Skid In modern industrial process control, accurate and stable pressure measurement is essential for safe and efficient operation. AOS Orwell pressure reduction systems combine robust design with advanced sensor technologies to deliver reliable and precise pressure reduction and measurement in demanding environments. For differential pressure measurement, two sensor modules can be integrated with a single transmitter. In hydrostatic level measurement, the transmitter digitally calculates differential pressure using process pressure and headspace pressure, supporting accurate and continuous measurement under changing process conditions. Process Analysis Gas Analyzers Gas Composition Analysis Gas Chromatograph Our Gas Chromatograph is an advanced online process analyzer designed to provide continuous, real-time analysis of the composition and quality of natural gas and hydrocarbon streams. Applications include custody transfer, fiscal metering, process optimization and quality control across oil and gas, petrochemical, refining and LNG facilities. Chromatographic separation technology measures individual gas components and enables calculation of properties such as heating value, Wobbe Index, relative density, compressibility, molecular weight and energy content. The analyzers are designed for harsh industrial environments with high analytical accuracy, long-term stability and modular architecture for simplified servicing. Measurement that connects From field instruments to operational intelligence. Measurement technologies provide the process data required to improve safety, reliability, efficiency and environmental performance. speed Precision Reliable measurement across critical process variables. monitoring Visibility Real-time process and diagnostic information. verified Compliance Instrumentation aligned with applicable industrial standards. settings_input_component Integration Field devices and packaged measurement systems. Flare Measurement Flare Gas Metering The AOS Orwell-Endress+Hauser / SICK Flare Gas Metering Solution is an ultrasonic flow measurement system designed for continuous monitoring and quantification of flare gas. Applications span upstream, midstream, downstream, LNG and petrochemical facilities. The system is designed to measure highly variable flare gas flows, ranging from low purge flows to high-velocity emergency flaring conditions. It enables operators to quantify flare gas emissions, optimize plant performance, reduce hydrocarbon losses and support environmental reporting. Ultrasonic transit-time technology provides non-intrusive measurement with no moving parts, supporting minimal maintenance, reliability and long service life. AOS Orwell, a leading indigenous provider of oilfield services and solutions, proudly participated at the 2024 Edition of the Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) Nigeria Annual International Conference and Exhibition (NAICE). The event, held at Eko Hotel and Suites from August 5 to August 7, 2024, brought together industry leaders, experts, and stakeholders to discuss and showcase the latest advancements in the oil and gas sector. At the exhibition, AOS Orwell showcased cutting-edge technologies and turnkey project solutions at booths 27 and 29. The showcase highlighted AOS Orwell’s commitment to driving innovation and efficiency in the oil and gas industry, with a focus on delivering comprehensive services that cover the entire lifecycle of oil and gas projects. In recognition of AOS Orwell’s outstanding showcase, the organizers of the 2024 NAICE awarded the firm first position in the indigenous exhibitors’ category. Per the organizers, AOS Orwell was awarded first position, “for outstanding display of creativity and technical excellence” Speaking at the event, Mr. Akeem Ariyo, the Managing Director of AOS Orwell, remarked, “Our participation at SPE NAICE 2024 underscores our commitment to advancing the energy sector in Nigeria and beyond. This platform provided us with an invaluable opportunity to engage with our partners, clients, and industry peers, and to demonstrate how our solutions can contribute to optimizing oil and gas operations.” In a similar vein, Mr. Onochie Onyetenu, The Chief Sales and Marketing Officer at AOS Orwell mentioned that “The event not only enabled us to highlight our innovative solutions but to also anticipate future needs of the market, ensuring we continue to deliver solutions that facilitate sustainable growth for our clients in the oil and gas sector. Throughout the event, the AOS Orwell team discussed the company’s offerings and explored potential collaborations. content: AOS Orwell Reliable flow control and isolation Valves & Actuation Solutions AOS Orwell provides a comprehensive range of engineered valve, actuation, isolation, and pressure-protection solutions for demanding industrial applications. Supported by globally recognized OEM partners and our in-country engineering expertise, our solutions deliver precise process control, dependable isolation, safe emergency response, and long-term operational reliability. Precise process control Control Valves AOS Orwell offers high-performance Pressure Control Valves and Flow Control Valves designed to deliver precise and reliable process control across demanding industrial applications. Our Pressure Control Valves maintain stable process pressure, while our Flow Control Valves accurately regulate the flow of liquids, gases, and steam through continuous modulation. Supported by globally recognized OEM partners and our in-country engineering expertise, these solutions provide safe, efficient, and dependable performance. Globe valves, including angle and globe patterns, anti-surge and cryogenic valves Double-offset, triple-offset and OCT zero-leakage butterfly valves Manual and automated choke valves Pneumatic, diaphragm and manual actuators Applications: Severe-service valve solutions for high-temperature, high-abrasion and cryogenic processes across oil and gas, LNG, power and other process industries. Emergency isolation Emergency Shutdown Valves & Blowdown Valves AOS Orwell provides high-integrity Emergency Shutdown Valves and Blowdown Valves engineered to safeguard personnel, assets, the environment and critical process infrastructure. Emergency Shutdown Valves deliver rapid and reliable isolation of process equipment during emergency conditions, while Blowdown Valves enable the controlled depressurization of systems to minimize risk and protect plant integrity. Designed for safety-critical service and supported by our globally recognized OEM partners and local engineering expertise, these solutions provide dependable performance for upstream, midstream, downstream and power-industry applications. Isolation and regulation Gate, Globe & Check Valves We offer a comprehensive range of Gate, Globe and Check Valves designed to provide reliable isolation, flow regulation and backflow prevention across a wide range of industrial applications. Engineered for durability, safety and long service life, these valves are available in a variety of materials, pressure classes and end connections to meet the requirements of oil and gas, power, petrochemical and other process industries. Gate valves for dependable full-flow isolation Globe valves for accurate throttling and flow regulation Check valves for reliable backflow prevention Multiple body materials, pressure classes and end connections High-integrity isolation Trunnion Ball Valves Our ball-valve portfolio includes Trunnion Mounted Ball Valves and advanced Zero-Leakage Metal-Seated Ball Valves engineered for reliable isolation in the most demanding service conditions. Designed for superior performance in high-pressure, high-temperature, abrasive and corrosive applications, these valves provide exceptional durability, bubble-tight shutoff and reduced maintenance requirements. Supported by globally recognized OEM partners and our local engineering expertise, our metal-seated ball valves are backed by an industry-leading four-year warranty, delivering long-term reliability and confidence. Advanced sealing technology Double, Triple-Offset & OCT Butterfly Valves Our comprehensive range of Double-Offset, Triple-Offset and OCT Butterfly Valves is engineered to deliver reliable isolation and control in demanding process applications. Designed for exceptional sealing performance, durability and operational efficiency, these valves are suitable for high-pressure, high-temperature and severe-service conditions across oil and gas, petrochemical, power and process industries. Our patented OCT butterfly-valve technology introduces a fourth offset that provides tight shutoff up to Class 4 leakage. This enables the valve to perform both throttling and isolation functions within the same application. Overpressure protection High Integrity Pressure Protection Systems AOS Orwell provides complete High Integrity Pressure Protection System packages designed to protect process facilities from overpressure while eliminating the need for conventional relief systems in suitable applications. Engineered to meet stringent functional-safety requirements, our HIPPS solutions integrate high-integrity sensors, logic solvers and fast-acting shutdown valves to provide rapid and reliable isolation during abnormal operating conditions. These products can be configured with suitable manual, pneumatic, hydraulic or electric actuation systems and accessories to meet the required operating philosophy, shutdown time, control-system interface and safety classification. content: AOS Orwell End-to-end well delivery Well Construction Throughout the entire well-construction process, AOS Orwell provides seamless services that bridge the divide between drilling and completions. Through integrated activities and processes, we combine the right technology, experienced personnel, extensive in-country capacity, and several years of operational experience to deliver winning solutions in well construction and management. Well intervention Fishing We maintain one of the largest inventories of fishing tools in Nigeria and have more than 100 combined years of experience in fishing operations in-country. Our fishing specialists have successfully worked across many oilfields in Nigeria. During drilling, workover, or production activities, tools, junk, debris, or other foreign objects may become stuck in the well and disrupt operations. Our trained personnel use specialized fishing tools and proven recovery techniques to retrieve these objects, restore well access, and optimize the continued use of the well. Tubular running Casing & Tubular Running Services AOS Orwell is a prominent provider of casing and tubular running systems. We combine conventional and patented casing and tubing running technologies, including Top Casing Drive Systems, to get casing safely to total depth. Our solutions include casing and tubing running, hammer services, casing accessories, and bucking services. This integrated system creates a fundamentally superior process for getting casing to total depth—on time, every time—while delivering significant improvements in safety, performance, reliability, and efficiency. Well intervention Cased Hole Wireline & Slickline Services We offer a wide range of cased-hole wireline, slickline, and pipe recovery services designed to meet clients’ operational, intervention, and evaluation requirements. Our experienced and well-trained personnel, supported by our technical alliance partners, are positioned to deliver safe and efficient operations and dependable well-intervention solutions. We bring decades of pipe-recovery and electric-wireline expertise in Nigeria to both offshore and land-based operations. Well decommissioning Plug, Abandonment & Slot Recovery The plug-and-abandonment process involves installing permanent barriers to safely seal an oil well or a section of the well. Where casing retrieval is required for slot recovery or permanent abandonment, a dependable and experienced service partner is essential. With our broad tool inventory and operational expertise, we can recover casing while reducing intervention time across different installation types. For offshore and deepwater installations, we provide single-trip cutting and recovery solutions that help reduce lengthy intervention periods and associated project costs. Rental services Drillpipe Tubular Rentals Tubulars used in oil and gas production include drill pipes, pup joints, casing, and tubing. Because these assets are exposed to rust, wear, and demanding operating conditions, their maintenance, storage, and logistics can present significant operational challenges. We provide dependable tubular rental services and a broad range of tubing, drill-string, handling, and ancillary tools. This allows clients to access properly maintained equipment while reducing storage, ownership, and maintenance costs. Downhole performance Jar & Downhole Tools Downhole tools are used throughout oilfield drilling, completion, intervention, and workover activities. We provide a wide range of in-country drilling and downhole tools, supported by automated machine operations that improve efficiency and help reduce project time and cost. Our equipment is professionally managed and supported by efficient on-site services. We have the capacity to provide specialized tools that improve operational performance and minimize drilling and production costs, including drilling jars, fishing tools, drill pipes, tubular tools, wireline tools, and slickline equipment. Completion support Completion, Assembly & Hammer Services Our completion tools deliver customized and cost-effective solutions that support the well-completion process with dependable service quality and operational performance. Our hammer services provide an efficient solution for large-diameter tubular driving operations, including conductor and pile driving. The technology can operate at different angles, including horizontally and underwater, without significant energy loss. For conductor driving, we use high-performance hydraulic hammers capable of driving piles deeper and faster, improving operational efficiency while supporting environmentally responsible project execution. Well drilling Directional Drilling And Logging At AOS Orwell, we understand the need to minimize rig time while delivering a safely and efficiently drilled well. Whether the objective is exploration, appraisal, or development, we focus on more than simply reaching total depth. We support optimized well placement, formation evaluation, operational safety, and dependable project performance. Through our technical partnerships, we provide high-quality drilling technologies, including drill bits, mud motors, Rotary Steerable Systems, Measurement While Drilling, and Logging While Drilling solutions. Our personnel are trained to high competency standards and are equipped to deliver reliable results while maintaining strong cost and schedule performance. Manufacturing and repair Machine Shop & Fabrication Our Machine Shop and Fabrication Services deliver precision, reliability, and world-class quality in support of oil and gas operations. From manufacturing and refurbishing critical components to advanced welding and fabrication, every project is executed to recognized international standards. Our services include machining, threading, coupling, repair, and fabrication activities that help keep client operations running efficiently. Whether supporting drilling and completion, refurbishing damaged equipment, or building custom-engineered solutions, AOS Orwell provides dependable performance and technical innovation.
